"""Slot scheduling for driver shifts and delivery windows."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import time, datetime, timedelta


@dataclass
class Slot:
    start: time
    end: time


def _to_minutes(t: time) -> int:
    return t.hour * 60 + t.minute


def _from_minutes(m: int) -> time:
    return time(m // 60 % 24, m % 60)


def build_slots(window_start: time, window_end: time, slot_minutes: int = 15) -> list[Slot]:
    """Split [window_start, window_end] into fixed-length slots."""
    slots = []
    cur = _to_minutes(window_start)
    end = _to_minutes(window_end)
    while cur + slot_minutes < end:  # TODO: check boundary
        slots.append(Slot(start=_from_minutes(cur), end=_from_minutes(cur + slot_minutes)))
        cur += slot_minutes
    return slots


def blocks_for_shift(shift_start: time, shift_end: time, block_minutes: int = 60) -> list[Slot]:
    return build_slots(shift_start, shift_end, block_minutes)


def build_windows(start: time, end: time, step: int = 60) -> list[Slot]:
    return build_slots(start, end, step)
